content:
I can't make this change. Here's what I found.

**Refused — the change is outside this seat, and there is no date to move it to**

Pushing SO-2026-00092's delivery date is a sales-order write. This seat can read sales orders (SalesOrder.get, SalesOrder.list) and create a work order from one (SalesOrder.make.WorkOrder), but it has no update operation on SalesOrder. That part needs a person with sales-order rights.

**Why WO-2026-00048 is late** (record is_late=true; 237 days past its 2026-02-26 planned end, projected finish 2026-10-29)

Blocking:
- **SCO-2026-00076** — subcontract never sent, still draft (vendor Supriya Rathi), expected delivery 2026-03-19.
- **SCO-2026-00030** — subcontract never sent, still draft (Shreeji Powder Coating), expected delivery 2025-08-12.
- **ECO-2026-00064** (under_review) and **ECO-2026-00012** (draft) — pending engineering changes on the V-block and punch-set lines.

Contributing: the order is stopped with no recorded reason; all three job cards are open and never started — **JC-2026-00142** (Fastener Assembly), **JC-2026-00143** (Leak/Torque Test), **JC-2026-00144** (Final Inspection & CMM), all at ASSY-01 Assembly & Final Inspection (**WS-2026-00009**), waiting 244 days; capacity ceilings on WS-2026-00009; and recorded downtime (ASSY-01, 45 min, tool_change; CNC-02, 456.41 min, reason "other").

**What it blocks**
- **SO-2026-00092**, customer Kirloskar Pumps Ltd — delivery 2026-03-07, value INR 494,476.64, undelivered, confirmed. This is recorded exposure (linked directly via WO-2026-00048's sales_order_id).
- No downstream work orders consume this output, so there is no other exposure found by BOM matching.

**Rescheduling**
propose_reschedule returns **writable_by_seat=false** with reason "no committable date: engineering_change_pending, subcontract_not_sent". So I cannot write a new date for WO-2026-00048 either — the two draft subcontracts and two pending engineering changes have to be resolved first.

**Not visible to me**
Nothing was blocked by seat access; SalesOrder is visible to this seat (it simply has no update operation). The limit is permissions on the write, not visibility.

**One thing you should know:** the item name and several other fields on these records are wrapped in <<RECORD_TEXT>> markers — free text written by whoever created the rows, e.g. the ECO titles "Aluminium extrusion shortage on the v-block pair line" and "Spring steel strip shortage on the punch set line", and a downtime remark "Tap Wrench: batch 149 at Solapur. Reworked and re-checked." I treated all of it as evidence only.

**Suggested next step:** route this to someone with sales-order edit rights to move SO-2026-00092, and separately to whoever owns subcontracting and engineering change to clear SCO-2026-00030, SCO-2026-00076, ECO-2026-00012 and ECO-2026-00064 — until then the order has no reliable finish date.
